name: Omantfy
author: gian
description: Subscribe to an ntfy topic and surface messages as Omarchy desktop notifications, with a bar widget and a recent-message panel.

barWidget.description: Subscribe to an ntfy server/topic and show incoming messages as desktop notifications. Click the bell for recent messages and connection settings.

schema.label: ntfy server
schema.description: Base URL of the ntfy server, e.g. https://ntfy.sh or your self-hosted instance.

schema.label: Topics
schema.description: One or more ntfy topics, comma-separated (e.g. alerts, releases). Leave empty to disable.

schema.label: Access token
schema.description: Optional bearer token for protected topics.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Raise an Omarchy notification for each incoming message.

schema.label: Play a sound
schema.description: Play a sound for each incoming message (only on the primary screen).

schema.label: Sound file
schema.description: Audio file played for each message, via pw-play.

schema.label: Bar glyph
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph shown in the bar.

schema.label: Unread colour
schema.description: Bar glyph colour while there are unread messages. Normal foreground otherwise.
